title: Toronto death ray inventor and Mossad missing time

tellings.quote: I'm familiar with a with a newspaper clipping from Toronto, Canada from the 19 late '50s, early '60s that talked about how there was a gentleman that invented a death ray, but for the people that came to go visit him, there were some Mossad representatives that went to go see him. They reported missing time,

plain: A researcher named Dave Rossi told podcast host Jesse Michels about a newspaper clipping from Toronto, Canada, from the late 1950s or early 1960s. Rossi says it described a man who claimed to have invented a death ray, and that visitors from Mossad, Israel's intelligence service, went to see him and afterward reported missing time, a stretch of time they could not account for. If true, it would tie a strange invention to an experience often linked with unexplained encounters.
